name: Homebridge
description: Homebridge is a tool that brings Apple HomeKit support to smart home devices that don't support it natively. Self-host it on your own server with Panara Cloud, which deploys Homebridge as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Brings HomeKit support to smart home devices. Deploy Homebridge with Docker Compose on Panara Cloud in minutes – free, open source, self-hosted.
